new_results.statement: For a completed physical 2x2 pair, S[L,M]=A[L,M]-C_L B^{-1}C_M^T and rank of the correction is <=2, hence s1(S[L,M])>=s3(A[L,M]).

An invertible indefinite physical pair with determinant magnitude D and kappa=smin(B), together with a disjoint post-puncture cross block having s3>=sigma, gives ||p_Q||inf <=3(6B1)^(2/3)D^(-1/3)kappa^(-1/6)sigma^(-1/6), B1=(2+sqrt(pi))(4e)^(1/4). Essential boundedness only.

Under |Aii|,|Ajj|<=1/64 and |Aij|>=1/32, any disjoint post-puncture cross s3>=2^-16 pays the full law with ||p_Q||inf<5034; every unpaid entry-heavy pair therefore leaves all disjoint punctured cross blocks below 2^-16 in s3.
